name: plot
purpose: A line or dots through a derived series of {x, y} (from expr with over), drawn on its axis.

series.doc: the state key of a list of {x, y}

dots.doc: dots in place of a line

label.doc: what the curve is, for a screen reader

ghost.doc: keep the curve from before the latest change, faint, so the learner sees what moved; changes less than half a second apart count as one (a line only)
